scale.label: Very Hard
scale.meaning: Very close related languages or compatible historical stages; understanding still takes a difficult check.

scale.label: Extremely Hard
scale.meaning: A larger stage, register or related-language gap; partial understanding is possible but unreliable.

scale.label: Insane
scale.meaning: Shared vocabulary offers a narrow chance of following material, including the broad inter-Romance baseline.

calibration_authority: U01: user-authored game scale. MI01-MI03 support caution about exposure, modality and asymmetry; they do not validate each historical row or assign engine scores.
direction: listener_language is a language known by the listener; target_language is what is spoken. An edge never grants speaking ability.
runtime_semantics: Spoken language checks use the maximum of accent difficulty, rated utterance difficulty and this listening floor. There is no graph closure, percentage conversion or stacking of allowances.
writing_semantics: Existing writing paths may reuse these edges; preserve their literacy and actual-script checks. The table is calibrated primarily for listening, not a guarantee of written comprehension.
missing_pair: Do not seed a row; runtime returns Impossible. No link is not an Insane link.
self_and_aliases: Never create self-edges or edges between aliases for the same canonical language. Accents stay inside their language, with independent accent difficulties.
stage_composition: Install the explicit row whenever both canonical stages are actually included, even when one is retained for learned use. Do not create an absent language to satisfy an edge.

legacy_reconciliation.baseline: Archive original directed language links and difficulty values along with names and accents before applying changes.
legacy_reconciliation.explicit_rows: The supplied edge overrides an unchanged stock row on the same canonical listener/target pair; detect and report builder edits with three-way reconciliation.
legacy_reconciliation.unlisted_positive_stock_rows: Preserve genuine original links not represented by the new matrix, with newDifficulty=max(VeryHard, oldDifficulty) for oldDifficulty in Automatic..Insane. Emit every such edge and its final value in the resolved implementation report.
legacy_reconciliation.impossible_rows: Keep explicitly Impossible/disabled records disabled; never clamp Impossible down to Insane.
legacy_reconciliation.builder_custom_rows: Preserve and report rather than silently clamping builder-owned settings. The 7..9 validation scope is unchanged stock plus newly authored historical links.
legacy_reconciliation.exclusion_scope: Modern, Middle-Earth, signed-language and unselected out-of-region content are not globally retuned by this historical pack.
legacy_reconciliation.preservation_note: Retain the original numerical setting in the source ledger, not as a competing active edge after calibration.
